To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the development of long-term profitability in the Icelandic fishing industry was facilitated by the abolition of export restrictions, introduction of an individual quota system and the development of a market system.

the Icelandic demersals value chain has been able to increase its profitability by focusing on a few species, by improving the quality of the product and by improving the efficiency of the production process.

the development of the Icelandic fishing industry is a result of the combination of a market oriented value chain, a market driven management system, and the development of a strong market connection between fishers, processors and consumers.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effects of fisheries management systems on market structure, which in turn affects the long run profitability of fishing and fish processing.

how the Icelandic fishing industry has out performed the Norwegian fishing industry, and how the management system in Iceland, which is based on individual quotas, has been important for the Icelandic fisheries.
the long run development of the Icelandic and Norwegian fishing and fish processing industries, and the effects of fisheries management systems on value chains.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

ITQs are not the only important factor for profitability in the Icelandic fishing industry, but they are important, and that the market connection between the different stages in the value chain is equally important.

the Icelandic fishing industry has been able to increase its profitability by adapting its management system to the market structure, and that the management systems in the two neighboring countries have developed in a way that has facilitated the development of market oriented value chains.
ITQ management has been successful in the Icelandic fishing industry.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a well-functioning market is essential for the long run profitability in the fishing industry, and that the Icelandic market system is a good model for other countries to follow.

ITQ management is not a panacea to ensure profitability in the fishing industry, and that a market connection from consumers to fishers is essential for the full realization in profitability in the fishing value chain.
the development of a market oriented fishing industry is dependent upon a strong market connection between consumers, through the retail stage, to fishers.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the Icelandic demersals fish value chain has been able to achieve long run profitability through the combination of a market oriented approach to management, the establishment of a strong connection between the fishing industry and fish processing, and the ability of the fishing fleet to respond to market signals.
management of fisheries is not just a technical matter of regulating fishing effort.

the Icelandic fishing and processing industry has been able to develop a market oriented approach to fishing and processing, and that ITQ management has played a key role in facilitating this development.
